altPlaceholder: Describe this picture for someone who can't see it
altPrompt: How would you describe this picture and its context to someone who is blind or has low vision? The description goes with the cell when it is copied, sorted or saved.
copyFirst: Copy a range of cells first, then paste it as a picture
couldNotPlace: Could not place that picture in a cell
fromFormula: This picture comes from a formula: give IMAGE its alt text as the second argument
linkedNoCrop: A linked picture shows its whole range: change the range in the formula bar instead
linkedPasted: Linked picture of {ref} pasted. It follows the cells; its reference shows in the formula bar
notARange: {entry} is not a range the picture can show
nowFloats: The picture now floats over the cells
nowInCell: The picture is now in the cell
protected: This sheet is protected. Unprotect it to change its pictures
protectedNamed: {name} is protected. Unprotect it to change its pictures
rangeTooLarge: That range is too large, or all hidden, to show as a picture
selectCellPicture: Select a cell holding a picture
selectPlacedPicture: Select a cell holding a picture placed in it
selectToPlace: Select a picture to place in a cell
unreadable: That picture could not be read
